description.p: A modern replica of AD&D Core Rules 2.0, the 1998 Windows character manager for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons 2nd Edition. It reads and writes the data files of the original program, so characters made in either program open in the other.
The app contains no rules content. It opens a Core Rules 2.0 (or Expansion) installation you already own, or its CD. It offers:

ul.li: The Character Generator: new characters with the Core Rules or Player's Option, editing, experience and levels, parties and the character sheet
NPC, treasure and encounter generators and Table Rolls
Editors for races, classes, items, kits, spells, psionic powers, monsters and traps
Import and export of DM Toolkit packages
The rule books in a reader, and the races, classes, items, spells, psionic powers and monsters of the installation
An interface in English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, French and German

description.p: This is a release candidate for version 1.0.

screenshot.caption: A character made in the original program

description.p: Second release candidate for 1.0: opening the mounted Expansion CD or its ISO image copies it to this computer, and everything made is saved there instead of failing on the read-only disc.
Release candidate for 1.0: the fixes from the full test round of 0.9.0, an encounter's Re-roll that keeps hand-set hit points, and a psionicist's Psionics step in New Character.
Beta: the screens of Update Character, Enter Character, kits, every part and template editor, Help on every screen, and the original's remaining dialogs.
Beta: monster types, monsters, races and characters show their pictures, and encounters say why an NPC was not generated.
Beta: Extract Data from CD… copies the rules data from the Core Rules CD or its ISO image, with no script.
Beta: packages made with the patched Expansion import, and the community add-ons come as one package.
Beta: the Weapons section has a sword icon.
Beta: the interface speaks six languages.

ul.li: Interface in Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, French and German besides English
Preferences chooses the language; the system's language is the default

description.p: Parties, the Expansion as the place for new content, and Windows' list order.

ul.li: Manage parties and delete characters, with Undo
Core Rules 2.0 installations open read-only; Import Core Rules 2.0 brings their characters and records into the Expansion
Lists sort exactly as Windows sorts them
Player's Option NPCs choose kit languages and pay base prices as the original does
The Flatpak and the AppImage use the GNOME 51 platform

description.p: Records and characters can now travel in DM Toolkit packages.

ul.li: Import and export .xpx (Expansion) and .xpt (Core Rules 2.0) packages, as the originals do
Create a package and edit one, adding or removing records and characters

description.p: Treasure, encounters and NPCs can now be generated.

ul.li: Treasure and encounter generators, with saved bundles, encounters and 2-20 tables
NPC generator for Core Rules and Player's Option NPCs, alone or in groups
Book reader, Table Rolls and editors for every user database
Run without Wine from a data package made from an installation

description.p: Characters can now gain experience, and their sheet can be printed.

ul.li: Add experience and level up, with hit point rolls, Skills & Powers points and racial level limits
Spell slots per spell level when memorizing spells
Character sheet: view, print, save as PDF and export HTML or text

description.p: Characters can now be created and fully edited.

ul.li: New Character wizard with Core Rules and Player's Option (Skills & Powers) creation
Edit proficiencies, languages, spells known, spellbooks and memorized spells
Edit every equipment group with quantities, and spending money
Humans can add a class (dual-class) under the Player's Handbook rules

description.p: New app icon: a burgundy tome with the dragon ampersand.

ul.li: Opens Core Rules 2.0 and Expansion installations, or their CD
Browses characters, races, classes, items, spells, psionics and monsters
Edits characters and saves files the original programs open
